state.requested_object: A single small gold hoop earring with a connected turquoise bead pendant. Make the opening clearly visible. The assembled object must fit within 28 mm. The pendant must physically touch its attachment. Lay the hoop in the XY plane.

geometry_family.instructions: Classify the requested design from its description. Use defer if the design is unclear.

criteria.open_ring: A loop or hoop with a visible opening, possibly with attached decorative parts.
criteria.flat_silhouette: A solid flat outline, such as a star, without raised lettering or a base disk.
criteria.layered_badge: A badge with a supporting base and raised logo details or lettering.
criteria.defer: The description does not support one of the geometry families.
